title: Register as a combat sport promoter
what: Arrange combat sport contests (such as boxing, kickboxing or mixed martial arts) only as a promoter registered for the class of contest.

sources.title: Combat Sports Act 2013 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An individual must not arrange a combat sport contest unless the individual is registered as a promoter of the registration class applicable to that contest

reach.condition: if it promotes combat sport contests
